# Dev branch feature and page report — 1 August to 12 October 2026

This report explains what was added or changed on `dev` during the requested period, where each feature lives, how its pages are routed, and which commits provide the evidence. Dates are interpreted as **day–month–year**: `1-8-2026` means **1 August 2026**.

## Scope and evidence

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Window | 2026-08-01 00:00 Africa/Cairo through the latest fetched dev commit on 2026-10-12 |
| Reviewed branch | dev; origin/dev was fetched and matched the local branch |
| Snapshot | [`c44130f86`](https://github.com/techlab2025/hse-system/commit/c44130f865706a5649bd9fc55a86d631f3d75696) — 2026-10-12 10:36:41 +03:00 — internal audit updates |
| Baseline | [`18bb3f025`](https://github.com/techlab2025/hse-system/commit/18bb3f025ea902ce26400e15cbe714a0c11aad23) — 2026-07-30 16:42:33 +03:00 — last first-parent commit before the window |
| Commits | 509 reachable commits: 462 non-merge and 47 merge commits; 284 first-parent entries |
| Net changed files | 2,713: 1,371 added and 1,342 modified; comparison uses no rename detection |
| Historical touched paths | 2,961, including temporary files and changes later reversed |
| Changed Vue files | 783 net added/modified .vue files; not all are standalone pages |
| New page-view files | 87 added .vue files under src/views; direct feature-component routes are counted separately |
| New URL paths | 149 unique organization/admin URL paths after expanding nested and shared routes |
| API registry changes | 183 added/changed getter definitions; see the API inventory |

**Date meanings:** “source activity” uses the commit’s recorded committer date. “On dev” follows the first-parent history and gives the commit/merge through which work became reachable from `dev`. There are 86 commits whose recorded commit day differs from their dev-entry day. These dates establish source-history availability, not production deployment or feature acceptance.

**New versus updated:** an added file or route is identified by comparison with the baseline. A change to a long-standing form is described as an enhancement or maintenance, not a new feature. Duplicate/cherry-picked commits remain in the commit appendix for traceability; they are not counted as separate product features. Temporary copied files are marked explicitly in the file inventory.

**Limits:** this is a frontend repository report. API definitions document frontend integration, not proof of a backend deployment. No browser acceptance test, production release verification or backend audit was performed. Uncommitted working-tree edits are excluded. Source links refer to repository-relative paths; commit links pin the historical evidence. Environment values and credentials are not included.

## Period overview

| Period | Commits by committer date | Main work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| August 2026 | 57 | Daily talks; project and equipment improvements; investigation table/status work; incident/observation presentation and validation. |
| September 2026 | 368 | Project setup flow, drills, meetings, permit to work, employee tasks, management of change, leadership visits, risk assessments, PPE, inductions, project summaries, certificates, attachment matrix and shared CRUD improvements. |

Existing safety-event, investigation, workforce, catalog and website-admin pages also changed.

## Feature-by-feature explanation

### 1. Daily / Today Talks

Record daily safety talks and make their history available from organization and project contexts. Added talk creation, listing, summary, history and detail dialogs. August work introduced talk/meeting integration and adjusted participant selection; September changes included save-and-new behavior. The project route supplies context while the organization routes provide a general entry point.

**Dates:** source activity 2026-08-04 → 2026-09-09; included on dev 2026-08-04 → 2026-09-10. **Files:** 18 historically touched; 18 retained additions and 0 retained modifications. These are scoped file dates, not a claim that every component was first introduced on the first date.

### 2. Guided project setup and onboarding

Build a project in five steps: basic data, holidays, positions and employees, teams, and equipment. Added a resumable wizard with route-controlled step selection, progress tracking, existing-project loading and separate request objects for each step. Later work improved position and team selection, equipment assignment, validation and responsive layout. Existing organization setup/progress screens gained cloning and department/position handling.

**Dates:** source activity 2026-08-03 → 2026-10-11; included on dev 2026-08-03 → 2026-10-11. **Files:** 93 historically touched; 78 retained additions and 14 retained modifications. These are scoped file dates, not a claim that every component was first introduced on the first date.

### 3. Project summary, resource pages and project details

Provide a project overview and drill-down lists for operational resources and safety activity. Added a summary page, summary API/model and resource list route. Resource keys include locations, zones, equipment, employees, teams, hierarchies, contractors, drills and meetings. The summary combines safety, operational and activity counts with a loss-time matrix. Project detail work also improved headers, section navigation, loading states and project-scoped links.

**Dates:** source activity 2026-08-03 → 2026-10-05; included on dev 2026-08-03 → 2026-10-05. **Files:** 15 historically touched; 10 retained additions and 5 retained modifications. These are scoped file dates, not a claim that every component was first introduced on the first date.

### 4. Project drills and drill planning

Plan project emergency drills, record their timeline and manage follow-up actions. Added drill creation and detail dialogs, planning/timeline editing, drill actions and corresponding API/model layers. Drill types have their own shared catalog pages. Drill operations are embedded in project details and the project summary resource list rather than a separate project-drill route.

### 13. Internal audit plans and audit register

Create and track internal audits with dates, scope, standards, auditors and a timed audit schedule. Introduced the internal-audit workspace and register, draft/publish workflows, audit plan loading and supporting API/model layers. ### 25. Home, permissions, navigation, notifications and shared form behavior

Keep the shared application shell, access rules, forms and data services aligned with the expanded feature set. Updated home cards/statistics, organization/admin navigation, employee access, permissions and serial-number configuration. Added or refined notification read/unread behavior, HTTP 429 handling, translations, required-field validation and reusable selects. Save-and-new was applied across many existing create pages using a stay-on-page router wrapper. Large cleanup commits touched many modules without creating new business capabilities.

## Shared maintenance and supporting changes

Several wide commits change many folders without adding a new business feature. For example, the September 9 save-and-new commits update create forms across organization settings and website administration; the September 15 cleanup removes unused imports from many existing modules. The module/file inventories retain these changes, but they should not inflate the count of new product features.

| Area | Explanation | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Save and New | Create forms can save, reset and remain on the page using a router wrapper. This applies to many pre-existing admin/settings/website forms. | [src/shared/utils/createStayOnPageRouter.ts](<src/shared/utils/createStayOnPageRouter.ts>); [`5341eaf0e`](https://github.com/techlab2025/hse-system/commit/5341eaf0e0b58a7597eb59e73986a192fdab2e41) |
| Selects and creation dialogs | Shared select behavior, reload, dialog visibility and inline creation support changed; audit scope uses department/activity creation dialogs. | [src/shared/FormInputs/UpdatedCustomInputSelect.vue](<src/shared/FormInputs/UpdatedCustomInputSelect.vue>); [src/features/Organization/InternalAudit/Presentation/components/plan/InternalAuditPlanTab.vue](<src/features/Organization/InternalAudit/Presentation/components/plan/InternalAuditPlanTab.vue>) |
| Translations and terminology | English/Arabic text, labels and feature translations were updated throughout operational and catalog screens. Exact files appear below. | [src/features/Organization/featureTranslation.ts](<src/features/Organization/featureTranslation.ts>) |
| Permissions and navigation | New workflows added enum values and sidebar/home entry handling. Registered routes alone are not proof of permission to access them. | [src/features/users/Admin/Core/Enum/permission_enum.ts](<src/features/users/Admin/Core/Enum/permission_enum.ts>); [src/shared/LayoutComponents/AdminSidebar.vue](<src/shared/LayoutComponents/AdminSidebar.vue>) |
| Website administration | Existing website content modules received create/edit/form and cleanup updates. The module index lists each content family; these are not newly created public website products. | See website/* modules and /admin route entries. |
| Tooling | package.json changes vite-plugin-vue-devtools from ^8.0.0 to ^8.2.1; lockfile and Vite/container configuration also changed. | [package.json](<package.json>); [vite.config.ts](<vite.config.ts>); [docker-compose.yml](<docker-compose.yml>) |
| Regression check | An NCR detail regression script was added. Its presence is evidence of test code, not a claim that it was executed for this report. | [scripts/ncr-details-regression.ts](<scripts/ncr-details-regression.ts>) |
| Documentation | Project flow/summary, objectives, organization documents, internal-audit API, general CRUD and developer guide documents were added or updated. | [README.md](<README.md>); [src/features/Organization/InternalAudit/documentation/README.md](<src/features/Organization/InternalAudit/documentation/README.md>) |

**Data-flow guide for the file inventory:** page/view → presentation component → controller → use case → repository → API service. Params serialize/validate requests; models map responses; enums define statuses/types. Some features use shared components directly. Presence of a layer does not establish that every screen or endpoint has been exercised.

## Reproducing and updating this report

The snapshot and baseline hashes above make this report reproducible even after dev changes. Commands used for the core evidence:

```bash
git fetch origin dev
git rev-parse dev origin/dev
git log dev --since="2026-08-01T00:00:00+03:00" --until="2026-10-12T23:59:59+03:00" --format=fuller --name-status --no-renames
git log --first-parent --reverse 18bb3f025ea902ce26400e15cbe714a0c11aad23..c44130f865706a5649bd9fc55a86d631f3d75696
git diff --name-status --no-renames 18bb3f025ea902ce26400e15cbe714a0c11aad23 c44130f865706a5649bd9fc55a86d631f3d75696
git show c44130f865706a5649bd9fc55a86d631f3d75696:src/router/index.ts
```

Route inventories were expanded from the route-module arrays and helper functions at both revisions, including nested equipment-management children and shared admin/organization registrations. Feature narratives were checked against source files, existing documentation, changed paths and commit evidence. Report verification checked counts, complete path/commit coverage and local source links; it did not run or modify application functionality.
